cells.reason: The anchor ca_swrcb_crvi_drinking_water_10 is the California SWRCB drinking-water MCL (0.010 mg/L, Title 22 s.64431, effective 2024-10-01) scoped to 'drinking water' delivered by community and nontransient-noncommunity public water systems; the regulation page itself states it 'does not set ... a food contaminant level' and 'should not be compared directly to a food-occurrence concentration', and the protocol places drinking-water rows outside the food-content basis family, so tests (a) and (b) both fail for canned seafood (canned tuna, canned fish). The register contains no sovereign Cr-VI food-content ML for any food, so the nearer same-basis instrument for this cell is the species-bounded-by-parent-total form (Cr-VI at or below total Cr) using the in-force total-chromium rows: GB 2762-2025 Table 7 item 5.1 'Aquatic animals and their products' total Cr 2000 ug/kg (effective 2026-09-02; explicitly reaches processed/canned fish products) and HK Cap 132V 'Fish' total Cr 1000 ug/kg where the Schedule's fish entry is read to reach canned fish in the edible portion. Derived and blind values are the anchor's face value of 10 ug/kg because no stricter same-basis Cr-VI candidate exists; the number this adjudicator would actually publish on this basis is the total-Cr bound named above, disclosed as bounded rather than as a water-MCL read-across.
